prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1074; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by another vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, exclusively to this office. Do not contact our client directly or through any third party.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the accident.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster reports, telematics information, and any other materials in your possession or control. Please confirm in writing that these items are being retained.

We look forward to your prompt response.
